name: btop
description: Resource monitor with mouse support, game-style UI, and process trees

tools.description: Interactive resource monitor with mouse support and colorful interface
tools.usage:
btop # Launch full-featured system monitor
btop --utf-force # Force UTF-8 characters for better graphics
btop --preset=0 # Use minimal preset configuration
btop --help # Show all command line options and key bindings
btop4win # Alternative launcher name for Windows version
